title: Extra Time for True Love
idea: Before a bare studio backdrop, two spirited sweethearts sit on folding chairs, confessing their courtship directly to a warm off-camera director. Budi lives for the capital’s fierce red-clad football club, while Maya prefers quiet weekend botanical gardening. Their autumn wedding date clashes with a massive October twenty-sixth match, threatening their union unless Budi proves love transcends the pitch. Staged memories blossom into tender, hilarious reenactments, until Maya reveals a secret to the lens: she orchestrated the schedule clash to see if he would truly choose her.
visual: An intimate, warmly lit minimalist studio where two expressive lovers sit on modest wooden chairs against neutral acoustic curtains, flanked by scattered orange petals and a scuffed leather football. The atmosphere is tenderly candid, warm, and playfully theatrical.
